inputs.original_text: Daijiworld Media Network - Palakkad Palakkad, Mar 28: Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday strongly refuted allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, asserting that the accusations are politically....
inputs.modified_text: On March 28 in Palakkad, Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan dismissed allegations of Rs 700 crore corruption over the proposed Cooperative Department software project as “political.” That is no substitute for answering straightforward questions about public money. Cooperative institutions exist to serve their members and the public, not to be shielded from scrutiny by political labels. If the project is being handled properly, clear disclosure should make that plain. Accountability protects trust and order; evasion only deepens suspicion.
